Email Processing

class case_handler.case_utils.form_handlers.mail.email_processing.parser.EmailParser(tmp_dir: Path, source_ref: str)[source]

Parses EmailMessage to extract headers, recipients, date, subject, body, and attachments.

class case_handler.case_utils.form_handlers.mail.email_processing.saver.EmailSaver(dest_dir: str | Path)[source]

Responsible for saving parsed email components to disk: - original EML content - plain text body - HTML body - headers snapshot

save(ref: str, *, body_text: str | None = None, body_html: str | None = None, headers: str | EmailMessage | None = None, eml_bytes: bytes | None = None) → None[source]

Save the various pieces of an email:

  • {ref}.eml : raw email bytes

  • {ref}.html : HTML body (if provided)

  • {ref}.txt : plain-text body

  • {ref}.headers: headers snapshot (string form)

Args:

ref (str): Identifier for file naming. body_text (str, optional): Plain text content. body_html (str, optional): HTML content. headers (str | EmailMessage, optional): Email headers. eml_bytes (bytes, optional): Raw .eml bytes.

class case_handler.case_utils.form_handlers.mail.email_processing.service.ProcessEmailService[source]

Orchestrates email processing: parsing content, saving files, moving attachments, and returning structured data or a Mail entity.

process_submitted_email(msg: EmailMessage, submitter: str, tmp_dir: str) → dict | None[source]

Process an EmailMessage: - Save raw EML temporarily - Parse content and attachments with EmailParser - Move attachments dir to final structure - Save all parsed output with EmailSaver Args:

msg: The email message object to process. submitter: Identifier for the submitting user. tmp_dir: Temporary directory to hold processing files.

Returns:

dict containing parsed email data, or None on failure.

Recursively delete a directory. Optionally delete its parent if it becomes empty.

case_handler.case_utils.form_handlers.mail.email_processing.utils.sanitize_filename(filename: str, id_num: int, default_base: str = 'attachment') → str[source]

Sanitize a filename for safe filesystem usage: - Replace non-alphanumeric/included punctuation with “_” - Collapse spaces and underscores into single underscore - Limit name length (~200 chars total including extension)
